_comment: The tester links the door journeys are driven with. STAGING ONLY.
These strings are in a repository, so seeding them into production would
be publishing a key: `scripts/tokens.mjs seed-fixtures` refuses without
Every one of them is IDEMPOTENT under the walk. The shared link has no use
limit, so admitting through it a thousand times only counts to a thousand;
the other three are refused before anything is written, so the suite never
changes a record and never needs re-seeding between runs. The one thing
deliberately not walked end to end is spending the LAST use of a counted
link - that is a state change, and it is proven in worker/tokens.test.ts
where it can be run a hundred times.

wg-fixture-shared-0000000000.label: e2e: the shared link every journey walks in through

wg-fixture-spent-00000000000.label: e2e: a counted link with nothing left on it

wg-fixture-revoked-000000000.label: e2e: revoked while it still had uses and time left

wg-fixture-expired-000000000.label: e2e: ran out of time on the first of January 2020
